### Added
- **Sessions list and message each other: kagent's MCP server is registered with muster** (giantswarm/agent-platform#705). With kagent's controller route and muster on, the connectivity chart renders `MCPServer kagent` in the `agent-platform` tool group and an in-cluster `HTTPRoute kagent-mcp`. The route serves `/kagent/mcp` on the data plane's plaintext listener, rewrites it to the controller's `/mcp` on the kagent backend, and sits behind `kagent-mcp-jwt`, a twin of the `kagent-controller-jwt` policy (the CRD takes one kind of target per policy). muster forwards the session's IdP token, so every call runs as the person who ran the turn. Agents on the `agent-platform` toolset preset get `x_kagent_list_agent_instances` (the person's other ready sessions) `x_kagent_invoke_agent_instance` (a message to one of them, answered when its turn ends; `kagent.controllerRoute.mcp.timeout`, default 300 s, the CRD's maximum) and the checkpoint and fork tools, and the Dev Portal's MCP servers page lists kagent in the Agent Platform group. `kagent.controllerRoute.mcp.enabled: false` turns it off. `make verify-kagent-route` asserts the route, the CR, the twin policy, the off switches and the path guard.
